parameters.command:
=cd /home/node
rm -rf {{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.repositorio }}
git clone https://{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.username }}:{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.token }}@github.com/{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.username }}/{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.repositorio }}.git
cd {{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.repositorio }}
git config user.name "{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.nome }}"
git config user.email "{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.email }}"
echo OK

parameters.query: SELECT id, name FROM data_table ORDER BY name

parameters.command:
=REPO="{{ $json.repositorio }}"
TABLE_NAME="{{ $json.tableName }}"
SAFE_NAME="{{ $json.safeName }}"
TOTAL_ROWS="{{ $json.totalRows }}"
BACKUP_DIR="/home/node/$REPO"
DATA_TABLES_DIR="$BACKUP_DIR/data-tables"
mkdir -p "$DATA_TABLES_DIR"
cat > "$DATA_TABLES_DIR/$SAFE_NAME.json" << 'JSONEOF'
{{ $json.jsonContent }}
JSONEOF
cat > "$DATA_TABLES_DIR/$SAFE_NAME.csv" << 'CSVEOF'
{{ $json.csvContent }}
CSVEOF
echo "SAVED: $TABLE_NAME ($TOTAL_ROWS registros)"

=export TZ='America/Sao_Paulo'
NOW=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
TAG_NAME="backup-datatables-$(date '+%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')"
BACKUP_DIR="/home/node/infra-alobexpress-backup"
if [ -d "$BACKUP_DIR/.git" ]; then
  cd "$BACKUP_DIR"
  git add data-tables/
  if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
    TOTAL=$(find "$BACKUP_DIR/data-tables" -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    git commit -m "$NOW - Backup Data Tables ($TOTAL tabelas)"
    git tag -a "$TAG_NAME" -m "Backup Data Tables - $NOW - $TOTAL tabelas"
    git push origin main
    git push --tags
    echo "[$NOW] Push concluido. $TOTAL tabelas. Tag: $TAG_NAME"
  else
    echo "[$NOW] Nenhuma alteracao detectada."
  fi
  cd /home/node
  rm -rf "$BACKUP_DIR"
  echo "[$NOW] Repositorio local removido."
else
  echo "[$NOW] ERRO: Repositorio nao encontrado em $BACKUP_DIR"
  ls -la /home/node/
fi
